title: Eidos component contract
description: The single machine-readable definition of 'a Eidos component is Done', spanning four surfaces: docs page, @eidos/ui export, Storybook story, registry item. Validated by scripts/check-contract.mjs.

version.description: Contract semver. Bump when a clause is added or changed.

dsVersion.description: Mirror of DS_VERSION (src/lib/site.ts). check-contract asserts equality.

generated.description: True once components[] is synced from disk by eidos-gen contract --sync.

rule.description: One-line plain statement of the invariant.

verifier.description: Verifier id (see scripts/eidos-lib.mjs VERIFIERS) or EXT:<npm-script>.

gate.description: block = exits CI/Stop nonzero on fail; advisory = reported only.

adr.description: Optional docs/adr/NNNN slug citing the settled decision.

components.description: One entry per component, generated by `eidos gen contract --sync`.

name.description: Canonical slug — the join key across surfaces (e.g. 'metric-card').

exportFile.description: File the export actually lives in (e.g. 'packages/ui/src/blocks.tsx'). REQUIRED for grouped barrels.

waivers.description: Explicit, reviewed exceptions. A clause failure with a matching, non-expired waiver resolves to status 'waived' — never silently 'pass'/green.

expires.description: Optional ISO date; after it the waiver no longer applies.
